title: multi-tool appointment (realistic, longer)
description: greet->verify_identity(conversation)->lookup(tool)->offer_slots(conversation)->book(tool)->confirm(say)->goodbye(say)->end. Exercises per-state tool-gating (book_appointment is NOT offered in the verify/offer states) plus a branch that is BOTH an expression transition (verify->lookup when the caller_name variable is set by save_contact_field) AND an llm_condition fallback on the same edge (fires when the judge sees the caller gave a name, even if the model wrote it under a different key) — a real-world robustness pattern, and it lets the suite exercise the expression evaluator and the batched llm judge on one state. offer->book is a second llm_condition branch on slot choice.

agent.name: flowbench-appointment
agent.system_prompt: You are a concise appointment assistant for a clinic. Follow the current conversation-state instructions exactly and call only the tools you are told you may call.

states.goal: Ask the caller for their full name so you can look up their booking. As soon as they give a name, call save_contact_field with key 'caller_name' and value set to the name they gave. Do not offer or discuss appointment times yet.
Tell the caller these two appointment slots are available and ask which one they would like: 2026-08-10 at 4:00 PM, or 2026-08-11 at 2:00 PM. Wait for them to pick one. Do not book anything yourself.

transitions.condition: the caller has told you their name
the user has chosen or agreed to one of the offered appointment slots

turns.user: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
Can you check what's available on 2026-08-10 at 4:00 PM?
The 2026-08-10 at 4:00 PM slot works for me.
Yes, please book it — my name is Karan Sharma, it is for a dental checkup, on 2026-08-10 at 4:00 PM.
